note: Companion to real-write.json (the raw automated run). The automated script creates a task and immediately tries to create a session; against the real backend that races the task's pipeline, so session creation returned 404 and every session-dependent write was blocked. This file records the real responses once the same disposable task reached status=done, so every write path the UI sends has an actual real-backend result. Every status below is an observed HTTP response, not a simulated one. Token was read from a mode-600 file and never appears here.
rootCauseOfAutomated404: pentest_api._resolve_task_dir(tid) raises HTTPException(404, '任务 <tid> 没有可用的运行目录 data/runs/task<tid>/full_*') when the task has no full_* run directory yet. The automated run POSTed the session milliseconds after POSTing the task, before the pipeline created the run dir. POST /api/pentest/projects/{pid}/sessions does not itself gate on task status, so it 404s purely on the missing run dir; it returns 200 once the task is done. This is a timing precondition of the audit script, not a frontend or endpoint defect. Recommended script fix: poll GET /api/tasks/{tid} until status is a terminal state before creating the session.
